state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 4.** `nvs-config` reads `[ldap.<name>]` and `[capabilities.ldap]` (`crates/nvs-config/src/ldap.rs`'s module doc). `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs` has an owned `Cursor`, and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` opens connections (`connect`, `open`) and runs `who_am_i`, `search` (an owned `Entries`) and `read`. Both module docs own those rules. `nvs-stdlib-ldap-connect-open-and-search`'s five tests pass against `samba-ad`.

`Core\Ldap\LdapError` is in the exception tree under `RuntimeError` with `kind` (`Core\Ldap\ErrorKind`, registered in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs`) and `code`. `fault_of` throws it for every LDAP failure, the URL walk's last failure included. `$code` is `?int`, not the record's `int`: a timeout or an unreachable server has no result code, so the slot stays `null` (the same reading as `Core\Db\DbError::$driverCode`). A program-built one starts at `Protocol`. `tests/conformance/error/an-ldap-error-is-in-the-tree-and-a-program-built-one-is-protocol-with-no-code.nvst` pins it.

Nothing else of `Core\Ldap` is registered in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`, so no Novis program can connect yet, and `ldap-connect-and-search-run`'s two `.nvst` cases are not written. `rule:security/ldap-pool-is-bound-as-its-block` stays `designed` until a Novis case guards it.

items.text: **The registry rows and helpers**: `Core\Ldap::connect`/`open`, `Ldap\Connection::search`/`read`/`whoami`, `Ldap\Entries` (over `nvs_stdlib::ldap::Entries` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:410`, whose `next` takes the `Ctx`), `Ldap\Entry` (`dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes`, `toArray`), `Ldap\Settings`, `Ldap\Tls`, `Ldap\Scope`, with a reference card for each, in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:1` beside `ERROR_KIND`. Follow the way `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/db/registry.rs:228` declares `Core\Db::connect`. `search` takes a `Filter`, so this slice needs the smallest `Ldap\Filter` (`equals`, `present`) from Stage 5. ADR 0278 § 3 and § 5.

**The two Stage 4 cases**: `tests/conformance/core/ldap-connect-and-search.nvst` and `ldap-connect-without-a-grant-throws.nvst`, the second also catching `Core\Ldap\LdapError` by name where the grant is present and the server refuses. Anchor: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:142` (`fault_of`). `rule:core-classes/db-capabilities` for the grant shape.

backlog: `open` connections are not pooled. ADR 0278 § 4 keys that pool on every URL, the user, a password digest, the TLS mode and the CA file (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs` module doc).

The `ldap:` pool and memo prefix shares its namespace with a `[db."ldap:x"]` block name. The downcast to `Held` keeps the two types apart, but a memo hit would throw "closed". Not checked whether any config rule forbids that name.
Ranged attributes (`member;range=0-1499`) are not merged yet; ADR 0278 § 5 puts it in Stage 6.
`Core\Ldap\LdapError` has no rule fragment yet; the goal's end moves ADR 0278 § 10 (with `$code` as `?int`) into one under `docs/rules/core-classes/`, beside `rule:core-classes/db-error`.
